Weights in (0, 1] are this project's convention, not measured moment arms: 1 = prime mover for that action, about 0.5-0.8 = strong secondary, 0.1-0.4 = assists. Directions use the rig signs (docs/done_development/r3-rig-move PLAN 2b.4): flex + forward (knee + = heel back, ankle + = dorsiflexion), abd + away from the midline, rot/pron + = internal/pronation, dev + = radial, inv + = inversion, hadd + = horizontal adduction; ipsi/contra = side bend or turn toward the muscle's own / the other side.
Muscle names: Z-Anatomy plain names from public/data/body/manifest.json (CC BY-SA 4.0).
